# Start as a Lead Hub participant
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

In about 10 minutes, you will register, wait for access approval, find a Learning Session, and use its materials and Q&A. You need the Lead Hub web address and an email address.

1. Open the Lead Hub web address and choose **Register**.
2. Enter your name, email address, and password. Submit the form.
3. Open the email-verification message when verification is required, then return to Lead Hub.
4. Wait for an administrator to approve your access. Until approval, Lead Hub shows the registration-pending page.
5. After approval, sign in and open **Classroom**.
6. Use search, category, or date filters to find a Learning Session.
7. Open the session. Use **Session Materials** to download a resource, or open **Q&A** and choose **Ask a question**.

You can edit or delete your own questions and answers. An administrator can moderate all session Q&A. See the [portal reference](../reference/portal-reference.md) for the available features.

If your access is revoked, you will be signed out and need an administrator to restore it.
